[About]

I'm Fardeen Sheikh — a photographer, videographer, graphic designer and video editor. My studio, Dream Films, documents weddings and stories with a cinematic eye: dramatic light, honest candid moments, and edits with rhythm.

From the first call to the final cut, everything runs through me — the shoot, the grade, the design, the edit. One vision, no hand-offs, no dilution.
